objective: Fix BUKLOD public Wall Android post header spacing by preserving a one-line author identity and aligning Following and Report beside the timestamp in the same right-hand column.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source 47eefd0c685f0c639227e9a887b1e1dda29b05e7 was read as the base on 2026-11-17; this is source-only and does not assert a live production OTA.
chosenApproach: Leave avatar in first column, identity metadata in second full-width column; render timestamp as flexing one-line text with a non-shrinking Following/Report action row alongside. Keep callbacks unchanged and add focused compact-layout and scope-lock coverage.
selectionRationale: Screenshot showed a right-aligned action row under full-width identity, creating a large empty band and separating author actions from the date.
preserveBehaviors: Follow and Report callbacks and access control are unchanged.
Full display name remains one line and avatar note still displays.
Photo, video, reactions, comments, AdMob inventory and feed data remain unchanged.
Existing production and staging OTA channels, package names and Expo runtime remain untouched.
acceptanceChecks: Focused header-navigation tests check name, avatar, date, actions, media and ad markers.
Run compact-layout gate and TypeScript in CI, with no physical-device validation claimed.
Engineering accountability gate must pass with explicit manifest and no blanket bypass.
Only publish a staging RC under separate exact-head verified OTA gates; do not auto-release production.
